summary: Tested new 'servizio_ospitalita' feature for Hospitality module: admin dialog conditional sections + backend round-trip + /api/me/events filter logic. All 5 states (da_definire, nessun_servizio, solo_ospitalita, solo_pasti, ospitalita_pasti) exercised through the UI; backend round-trip verified via pytest. Persistence after dialog close+reopen verified. State restored to 'da_definire' at end of test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >11000 lines; strong candidate for modularization (hospitality, auth, events, me) into separate routers.

/api/me/events/{event_id} filter logic for servizio_ospitalita could not be verified end-to-end because no password-auth user is linked to persons of ev_qa_1 and no lodgings/meals are assigned to person_fa782807a3; logic was verified by code inspection (lines 2765-2774 in server.py) and matches spec.

Hospitality.jsx 'Esigenze alimentari' box shows only when meals are enabled (per spec). OK; however, note that saveServizio does not persist 'esigenze' separately, which is correct per spec but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. All test mutations restored to 'da_definire' at the end of both the pytest suite and the Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Event with persons for hospitality is 'Maratona QA' (id ev_qa_1), NOT 'Maratona QA 2027'. hosp-event-select dropdown lists events by name; select 'Maratona QA' exact=True. Example person row: hosp-person-person_fa782807a3 (presence staff_973eb8d3ff). The 'Servizio ospitalità' Radix Select options are: 'Da definire', 'Nessun servizio', 'Solo ospitalità', 'Solo pasti', 'Ospitalità + pasti'. Backend endpoint is PUT /api/staff/<presence_id> {servizio_ospitalita}. /api/me/events/{event_id} cannot be tested as person_fa782807a3 (no password-auth user linked).
